p: Yiewsley High Street runs north from West Drayton station, which is on the Elizabeth line, so you can be in central London or out at Heathrow quickly. The Grand Union Canal also passes through the area, with a towpath that's good for a walk or bike ride.

It's a busy local high street with plenty of takeaways and cafés, and Uxbridge, with its bigger shopping centres and cinema, is just up the road. Heathrow is only a few miles away, so you'll hear the planes.
Reels Casino Slots is 18+ only, and as the stickers say, no smoking and no drinking inside.
